q: This paper proposes a specification-based Code–Text–Code reengineering framework for LLM-mediated software evolution.
r: IC1: an LLM code-to-specification-to-code reengineering pipeline, no coding agent, no SDD, context file or agent evaluation.

q: Context files such as AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, and SKILL.md provide project instructions and workflows
r: IC1: a dataset of DESIGN.md files with descriptive statistics only; no coding agent is used or evaluated and no cost or quality evidence for RQ2-RQ4.

q: we conduct a systematic review of recent primary studies to map the current landscape of LMA applications across various stages of the software development lifecycle (SDLC).
r: IC1: a broad review of LLM multi-agent systems across the SDLC with two small ChatDev game demos; not an evaluation or comparison of coding agents under controlled conditions.
